Compute the kde for a given group

Source: R/hr_kde.R
kde_one_group.Rd

This is the internal function that is called by hr_kde to compute the kde for a given group. It is not intended to be called directly by the user.

Usage

kde_one_group(xy, crs, bbox, res, h, id)

Arguments

xy

a matrix of coordinates

crs

the crs of the coordinates (to use in the geometry)

bbox

A named vector of four elements: xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax to define the bounding box of the grid over which to compute the KDE.

res

The resolution of the grid (in the units of the projection of x).

h

The bandwidth for the kernel density estimation.

id

The identifier for the group (used in raster metadata).

Value

A PackedSpatRaster.
